[issue by Yulapersii2522]
### Context

I have a Minecraft 1.21.1 server running on the magma core.
Forge 2.1.228, Java 21/22. When using Mechanical Bearing, the server crashes


### Crash Report

https://mclo.gs/lLtiOZR

[comment by VoidLeech (collaborator)]
Some other mod is adding an incorrect assumption into the constructor of the Level class. Try a binary search to find the offending mod so you can report it to them, it is a simple process:

1) Remove half your mods
2) Try to reproduce the issue
3) If you can, repeat from 1); otherwise, remove all mods, add back the mods removed in 1), then repeat from 1)
